reason: riscv64 CI fails across all 6 python variants with an identical solver error: no cross-python_linux-riscv64 candidates found. This is a missing conda-forge packaging dependency (cross-python not yet built for riscv64), not a code/build bug in this feedstock. All other platforms (linux_64, linux_aarch64, linux_ppc64le, osx_64, osx_arm64, win_64) pass, and the recipe already uses v1 format so no v1-migration concerns apply.
